source_instruction: i am looking for 3mp motion detection security camera.
query: Ugh, my neighbor’s golden retriever keeps digging up the marigolds I planted along the front walk, and I swear the squirrel that steals birdseed from my feeder is taunting me every morning, plus I burned the toast so bad yesterday the smoke alarm went off for ten whole minutes, and I still can’t get that one coffee stain out of my favorite canvas tote no matter what stain remover I try. I’ve heard 3mp video surveillance units with motion detection work well for keeping an eye on things around the property, and I’ve also noticed all the options I’ve glanced at so far sit right under a $70 price point.
